name: Pink Mask
source:
Pink Mask is a female superhero in disguise, travelling around helping those in need and aiding adventurers that are in itchy situations.  She made appearance only in the Rance 4.1 and Rance 4.2 games, where she first appeared in the dungeon infested with monsters below the Factory of the Happiness Pharmaceutical company. She mostly showed up in front of Rance, and assisted him in live or death situations, being somewhat of a Guardian Angel for him during his adventure in which he coincidentally didn't take Sill Plain with him, but [url=/c25632]Athena 2.0[/url] instead.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Pink_Mask]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
